title: 欧·亨利短篇小说选
background: Britannica（B273）：'From December 1903 to January 1906 he produced a story a week for the New York Sunday World magazine'；'Both The Four Million (1906) and The Trimmed Lamp (1907) explored the lives of the multitude of New York'——'the former contained the widely popular story The Gift of the Magi'。
风格（B273）：'His stories often had surprise endings, a device that became identified with his name'；'expressed the effect of coincidence on character through humour, grim or ironic'。
outline: 名篇谱系（B273+通说）：《麦琪的礼物》《最后一片叶子》《警察与赞美诗》等。
themes: 巧合对性格的作用（B273：effect of coincidence on character）。
小人物的温暖（B273 语境）。

influence.text: Britannica：'surprise endings, a device that became identified with his name'（B273）。

editions: 《欧·亨利短篇小说选》（人民文学出版社王永年译本，通说待核）。
reading.order: 先《麦琪的礼物》→《最后一片叶子》。
